mapper.select: SELECT id,order_id AS orderId,lease_token AS leaseToken FROM order_outbox WHERE (status='PENDING' OR status='RUNNING' AND locked_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND next_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE order_outbox SET status='RUNNING',lease_token=#{token},locked_until=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 15 SECOND,attempts=attempts+1 WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE order_outbox SET status=IF(#{success},'SENT','PENDING'),locked_until=NULL,lease_token=NULL,next_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 3 SECOND WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND locked_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_outbox WHERE status!='SENT'
